tracks.label: Payments
tracks.note: No card payments yet: there is no Stripe here. A notify-me sign-up collects the people who want it instead.
tracks.sellingNote: Card payments go through your own Stripe account, straight to you. Until you connect it and approve the products, the shop takes order requests by email.

google._comment: Where paid Google search ads show: geo target constants (2840 is the United States) and the language constant (1000 is English).

video._comment: Gemini Omni 1.2 always makes sound (asking for none is refused). When a 1.2 job fails at the provider, 1.1 gets one go; past both, the ad is a screen recording with captions. Prices are per second at 720p.
